summary.value: Amelie Bistro & Wine Bar is a French bistro and wine bar on Amsterdam Avenue on the Upper West Side, built around small plates and a long wine list. Restaurantji diners call it The best restaurant on the UWS, single out beef tartare, salade nicoise, moules-frites, burger as favorites, and say the staff make you feel at home the moment you walk in. It suits an early evening drink and snack or a relaxed neighborhood dinner.

description.value: Amelie Bistro & Wine Bar is a French wine bar and bistro on Amsterdam Avenue, serving small plates and more than 90 wines. Its happy hour runs every day, 4 to 6 pm. itineraryNote: Amelie Bistro & Wine Bar: a cozy French wine bar on Amsterdam Avenue; come for happy hour and try the $1.5 oysters with a $14 wine flights pour.
review1: Happy hour is Amelie's best-known draw, with regulars pointing to cheap oysters, small plates and wine flights that make it an easy early-evening stop.
review2: French bistro staples such as tartare, salade nicoise, moules-frites and the burger are the dishes diners return for, with the mussels getting particular praise.
review3: Warm, welcoming staff are a steady theme, with diners saying the team makes first-time visitors feel at home almost immediately.
review4: Crowds are the caveat: the room fills quickly even early in the evening, so diners recommend booking ahead rather than hoping to walk in.
